model: NeuTTS-2E Q4_K_M GGUF backbone plus FP32 ONNX NeuCodec

reference.reference_text: the scope of work for a future procurement.
reference.note: The crop was independently encoded by NeuCodec; it is not the original code slice [103, 206).

interpretation: An independently encoded 103-token crop matches the 207-token reference on content WER and retains comparable Angry probability and DNSMOS. The old prefix103 failure is therefore best attributed to incomplete linguistic/prosodic reference context, not to Angry requiring 207 tokens or to a hidden dependence on sliced codec codes.
limitations: One speaker, one emotion, three texts and three seeds.
The 2.06-second crop was selected from a known natural phrase boundary; automatic boundary selection is not evaluated here.
The tempo-normalized Emotion2Vec score is reported for traceability but is not used as a primary conclusion because phase-vocoder normalization is unstable for this classifier.
